text: In the next ten minutes, let us get to know him.
In Hindu tradition, three great gods care for the universe.
Brahma creates it.
Shiva transforms it.
And Vishnu preserves it.
Brahma begins each world, and Shiva brings it to a close. But through all the long ages in between, it is Vishnu who watches over life.

text: But sometimes, the world loses its balance.
Cruelty grows strong, and goodness is in danger.
For those times, Vishnu made a promise.
Whenever dharma fades, and darkness rises, I will come down — age after age.
Each time he comes, he takes a new form.
These are his avatars. The ten most famous are called the Dashavatara.
First came Matsya, the fish, who guided a boat of life safely through a great flood.

text: I bow to the one who lives in all.
So, who is Vishnu?
He is the calm of the deep ocean.
The protector, who never looks away.
The friend who returns, again and again, whenever he is needed.
He teaches that goodness is worth protecting,
that power should always serve kindness,
